slice: W228 offline structured materialized-view metadata and explicit physical target identity

claim.scope: Bounded quiescent Atomic declarations and current-local target identity, with the finite 11-case native catalog fixture and measured affected library controls.
claim.statement: Detached MV query/context/tagged target metadata and conservative direct syntactic FROM inventory are exposed separately from explicit target resolution; view data-access and W88 materializer fences remain intact.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST within the declared bounded scope after two source-backed analyzer counterexamples, corrected harness runtime boundaries, raw semantic forgery rejection and exact restoration.
claim.F: Executed compiling RED, source law checks, behavioral suites and raw audits; not a formal proof.
claim.G: One pinned source snapshot, separately pinned native runtime, 11 view cases, two guarded declarations, two negative resolver controls and one ordinary projection control. Not full SQL or all MV/layout forms.
claim.R: Root independently inspected delegated changes and serialized all heavy jobs. Luna review is correlated, not independent replication; a proposed restriction was retracted after root checked its enclosing parser context.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: public offline catalog API, bounded SQL interpretation and local metadata identity resolution.
boundaries.rollback: Revert the containing exact-path atomic local feature commit without discarding unrelated work; no remote push or history rewrite.
admitted: OfflineTable#materialized_view returns a detached descriptor; ordinary/synthetic tables return nil.
Preserved SELECT/WITH slice and declaring database; named, explicit inner UUID and implicit inner-engine tagged targets.
Source-free or one recognized direct relation may be complete; unsupported shapes report unknown, a reason and no partial references.
Catalog target-resolution overloads retain ownership/current database UUID checks and require the declared named or unique physical inner identity.
Reading an MV object stays guarded; resolving its target does not execute its query or prove Active/freshness.
retained_guards: Refresh/security/parameterized target declarations, unsafe statement/comment controls, source-invalid external TO plus inner ENGINE.
CTE/JOIN/multiple relation/subquery/table-function/set/IN ambiguities, SAMPLE and unrecognized suffixes, string-literal table names.
Missing/ambiguous/wrong-kind/changed targets and absent inner metadata; synthetic system targets.
W87 child completeness/preflight and W88 exact detached-only identity materialization.
not_claimed: Full SQL validation or a runtime INSERT-trigger, dictionary/function or refresh dependency graph.
Live activation, snapshot atomicity under concurrent metadata mutation, target data contents or freshness.
General MV/projection execution/writing, all types/layouts, full repository suite, broad facade decomposition.
Memory/performance optimization or the <=10 percent stock-reader gap; overall goal remains active.

architecture.organization: One file per new public descriptor/reference/parser owner; OfflineCatalog keeps bounded file and identity orchestration. W88's body-only SELECT gate is not widened.
architecture.type_roadmap_correction: Existing child serde composes recursively. Distinguish new leaf codecs, physical per-occurrence layout/state, consumer/admission integration, missing stock qualification and source-invalid trees rather than counting every unmeasured product as a missing serializer.
architecture.context_law: ParserCreateTableQuery's SharedSet/SharedJoin TO INNER UUID restriction is not an MV law; ParserCreateViewQuery has its own target construction. Persisted canonical qualification/UUID may differ from authored CREATE spelling.

source_reference.distinction: Shallow source snapshot and executable are separate pins, not one build or a continuing latest-master assertion.

verification.execution_owner: Root; compiler/native/Ruby/formatter jobs serialized, unchanged run_safe, min-free50%, one Crystal worker and isolated cache.

red.signal: Baseline compiles but new descriptor/resolver and bounded parsing cases fail; existing W86/W87/W88 controls pass.
